integrity: Exact moment equations are analytically derived; numeric independent finite-chain checks and quadrature are noncertifying consistency checks. Originality is based on specific literature comparisons and remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Statement concerns a self-consistent stationary single-site marginal Markov chain, and the iterated limit of large site multiplicity before critical regularization. It establishes neither a full finite-network covariance/variance law nor uniform finite-size bounds or distributional convergence. The within-site factorial moment identity is a known total-catastrophe birth-death formula; the claimed additional classification is its fitness-integrated critical scaling.
title: A hidden co-occupation threshold below fitness condensation
